note: ZERO-EVERYWHERE PROBE (A15.11), closed by A13.8. Baseline 2026-09-16 on the installed 0.4.18 wheel: 2 nodes / 1 edge, CONFIG_KEY 0; after A13.8 5 nodes / 4 edges (READS / DEFINES / SHARES_CONFIG). The SDK key is deliberately a literal, NOT process.env — an env read here would mint an unrelated CONFIG_KEY and flip the extract probe green while the flag itself stayed invisible.
